# Unblocked Games G+ Hub — Complete Technical & Catalog Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Canonical URL: https://agar-game.github.io/
> Short Index: https://agar-game.github.io/llms.txt
> Direct Game Portal: https://agar-game.github.io/lesson/
> Sitemap: https://agar-game.github.io/sitemap.xml

Unblocked Games G+ Hub (`https://agar-game.github.io/`) is a high-speed HTML5, WebGL 2.0, and WebAssembly browser game portal hosted on GitHub Pages. It consolidates the top playable titles from Unblocked Games G+, Unblocked Games 66 EZ, Unblocked Games 76, Unblocked Games 67, Unblocked Games WTF, and Classroom 6x into a zero-extension, school Chromebook-compatible web launcher.

## Hub Comparison Matrix

| Hub Name | Typical Hosting | Primary Focus | Common Issue | Unblocked Games G+ Advantage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Unblocked Games G+** | GitHub Pages (`/lesson/`) | 3D WebGL + 2D HTML5 Classics | None (Clean HTTPS directory) | 60 FPS, zero popups, instant tab cloak |
| **Unblocked Games 66 EZ** | Google Sites (`sites.google.com`) | Classic 2D HTML5 & Flash ports | Blocked by GoGuardian URL keyword rules | Hosted under clean `/lesson/` path |
| **Unblocked Games 76** | Google Sites / Mirror Subdomains | Sports, Retro Bowl, Moto X3M | Frequent mirror takedowns & dead embeds | 100% native HTML5 & Ruffle WASM |
| **Unblocked Games 67 & 911** | Google Sites Mirrors | 2-Player Local & Physics Games | Missing save persistence across mirrors | Persistent `localStorage` on one domain |
| **Unblocked Games WTF & Classroom 6x** | Custom Domains | 3D WebGL Shooters & Racers | Heavy ad scripts causing Chromebook lag | Lightweight zero-CLS layout |

## School Chromebook 60 FPS Optimization Guide
1. **Lock Browser Zoom at 100% (`Ctrl + 0`):** Prevents ChromeOS compositor scaling overhead on WebGL canvases.
2. **Use Native Fullscreen (`F4` or `F11`):** Hides the Chrome address bar and bookmark strip to maximize GPU viewport allocation.
3. **Close Background Memory Tabs:** Close idle Google Meet, YouTube, or Google Slides tabs to free RAM on 4GB school Chromebooks.
4. **In-Game Low Graphics Mode:** Set 3D shaders in Drift Hunters or 1v1.LOL to Low for locked 60 FPS frame pacing.
5. **Instant Classroom Tab Cloak (`` ` `` Backtick Key):** Toggles the document title to `Google Docs - AP Calculus Notes.docx` with one keystroke.
